newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Nice price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nice price target raised.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Tuesday it was raising its 12-month price target for Nice Systems Ltd and said the company's planned purchase of Canada's Dees Communications was on track.
"We are reiterating our 1-Buy rating and raising our 12-month price target from $30 to $40," Lehman analyst Tim Luke said in a report.

Lehman said Nice was continuing to see strong trends across its business in the current second quarter and forecast it would deliver revenue and EPS "comfortably in line with and possibly above our estimates of $14.2 million and $0.29".
The investment house said that following recent discussions with Nice management, it believed "good progress is being made in finalising the recently announced acquisition of Dees Communications".

Nice said last month it had signed a letter of intent to buy Dees, a provider of automated call centre monitoring solutions, for $8 million in cash and up to 500,000 ordinary shares. Nice produces digital systems that record and retrieve conversations.
Lehman said the acquisition was likely to expand significantly Nice's position in a rapidly growing call centre market.
"The company is on target to close this acquisition by the first week of July," Lehman said.
"We believe Nice should continue to experience strong sales momentum and think the company is well placed to establish additional distribution relationships," the report said.
